card.name: Linking words before drink exceptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as except, other than, or, including and a comma, right where a sentence is about to name a drink (usually water, milk or coffee). Mostly in bisphosphonate instructions to take the tablet with plain water only.

modes.label: Water-only exceptions
modes.description: Words like except or than that introduce plain water after a ban on food or drink.
